ideas.idea: Remove the Product JSON-LD from /shop or put one Product per product page, since the listing page is not a single product
ideas.why: The Product markup on the listing page is mislabelled, and the fix is specific to this file. It differs from the known issue about missing offers or reviews.

ideas.idea: Give each part its own page with price and description, listed in the sitemap
ideas.why: /shop is a single page with one line of text, so individual product pages would give crawlers and people specific pages to find.

ideas.idea: Show delivery terms in normal visible text, because the delivery notice is data-nosnippet
ideas.why: The report itself calls data-nosnippet a deliberate scoped choice, so this advice conflicts with that choice.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to app.html
ideas.why: app.html has no viewport tag, so this is a real gap that affects mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Wrap the content in a <main> landmark instead of a bare div
ideas.why: app.html wraps the body in a plain div with no landmark, so screen readers and parsers lack a main region.

ideas.idea: Add content and links on the home page about what is sold and link to categories
ideas.why: The home page has only an h1, so it gives no description of the products and no onward links.

ideas.idea: Give /search a description or a reason to exist for machines
ideas.why: /search is deliberately noindex, and the report says no change is needed, so any push to add machine-facing content there conflicts with that.

ideas.idea: Prerender the static pages with prerender = true as an alternative to removing ssr = false
ideas.why: The site has only a few static routes, so prerendering fits and addresses the client-side rendering problem.
